description: Get official US Treasury exchange rates used for government currency conversions. Pass a country name for one country's rate; omit it for the most recent rates across all countries.

country.description: Country name (e.g., "China", "Mexico", "Japan", "Canada"). Treasury indexes by country, not currency: the euro is "Euro Zone" (common aliases like "Eurozone"/"EUR" are accepted), and there is no United States row because these are rates from the dollar. Omit for the latest rates across all countries.

name: treasury_exchange_rates

outputSchema.description: US Treasury exchange rates. Indexed by COUNTRY, not currency — the euro is filed under "Euro Zone", and there is no United States row because these are rates from the dollar.

country.description: Echo of the country filter; ABSENT when the caller omitted it and got rates across all countries

mirror_fetched_at.description: Timestamp of the underlying rate data

note.description: Present when the live API was unreachable and the mirror answered

title: Treasury Exchange Rates
